versions.changelog: Security: scoped API key to MINIMAX only, pinned LLM endpoint, SSRF protection (HTTPS-only + private IP block). TP4: removed unimplemented LinkedIn/CRM/outreach-draft/paid-tier. LP3: added permissions + privacy + compliance notices. SQP-2: added compliance to marketing. Removed phantom Pro tier claim.

Initial public release of lead-enrichment-scanner.

- Automates B2B lead generation and enrichment from company names or domains.
- Outputs enriched contact records: decision-maker names, emails, LinkedIn profiles, and outreach drafts.
- Supports bulk processing, concurrency, resuming, and filtering/segmentation.
- Generates up to 500 leads per session with compliance guardrails (GDPR, public data, robots.txt).
- Offers configurable outreach draft tones and CRM-ready exports.
- Includes customization guides for SaaS founders, agencies, and B2B sales teams.
